normal.summary: Baseline observe-only profile for normal development. No cleanup is authorized.

focus.summary: Review-heavy profile for concentrated work. Cleanup stays disabled while background offenders are surfaced early.

stream.summary: Looser review profile for streaming or demos. Higher thresholds reduce false positives on live surfaces.

build.summary: Operator-approved cleanup profile for build windows. Only cleanup-enabled, policy-matched headless candidates can be stopped.

candidates.description: High-footprint browser workers stay notify-only unless policy explicitly allows background cleanup.
candidates.operatorHint: Review pinned tabs, downloads, and background browser workers before raising cleanup authority.

candidates.description: Collaboration clients are review candidates by default so the operator can decide what stays open.
candidates.operatorHint: Treat collaboration clients as operator-reviewed background load, not automatic cleanup targets.

candidates.description: Background launchers can be closed only in cleanup mode and only when they are headless.
candidates.operatorHint: Cleanup is allowed only for headless launcher/background helpers after dry-run receipts look sane.

candidates.description: Dedicated command-line marker for safe apply-mode verification.
candidates.operatorHint: This marker exists only for safe policy verification and should not be used as a general cleanup rule.
